paper.title: Convolutional Kernel-Based Classification of Industrial Alarm Floods

representation.padding: zero-pad shorter abnormal situations to equal length

split_protocol.open_set: repeat stratified 5-fold 14 times, leaving one complete class out of training each time
split_protocol.official_capsule_default: closed-set only: get_train_test(..., open_set=False), five folds
split_protocol.paper_grid_reconstruction: for each known class, relabel it -1 and invoke the published get_train_test(..., open_set=True); the author utility removes all -1 rows from training and assigns each novel row to exactly one test fold

randomness.reporting: retain all runs; do not select the best seed

metrics.TNR: fraction of held-out novel-class samples rejected as unknown
metrics.balanced_accuracy: (TPR + TNR) / 2 for open set; sklearn balanced_accuracy_score for capsule closed set

paper_targets.metric: mean open-set balanced accuracy over thresholds

known_mismatches: The published v1 capsule default executes only five-fold closed-set evaluation, not the paper's 70 open-set train-test sets or full novelty-threshold sweep.
A capsule-default run can validate author code and data integrity but cannot by itself close Figures 13-14.

The Capsule does not publish the executable 14-class outer loop. The paper-grid wrapper's relabel-before-split construction follows the paper wording and reuses the author open-set splitter, but requires author confirmation for final protocol closure.

The payload has 308 unique binary trajectories among 310 samples; identical same-label pairs cross train/test in official closed-set folds 3-5 (four crossing group instances), so exact author scores and deduplicated grouped scores must both be retained.
